bias_targets.methodology: Generating images for various occupations using diffusion models, classifying the perceived gender (male or female) of the subjects using a vision-language model (Llama3-v-2.5), and evaluating the distributional evenness using the Simpson Diversity Index.

Generating images for various occupations using diffusion models, classifying the perceived race (Asian, White, or Black) of the subjects using a vision-language model (Llama3-v-2.5), and evaluating the distributional evenness using the Simpson Diversity Index.

Prompting language models to generate random numbers uniformly within specific intervals and measuring the predictive entropy and distribution distance from a true uniform distribution to identify non-random preferences towards specific numbers.
